title: Return an established prior result without duplicating its effects

items.request.retry: The caller says the first response was lost and this is a retry
items.request.operation-id: The caller supplies the same operation identity
items.lookup.prior-outcome: A request for outcome and content binding by operation identity
items.store.prior-content-binding: The exact content bound to the prior operation
items.store.prior-effect: The durable effect of the prior operation
items.status.prior-success-exact-match: The store establishes prior success and exact content match
items.response.prior-result: The caller receives the established prior result and no-new-effect notice
items.durable.duplicate-effect: A second durable copy of the prior effect

steps.note: Send retry intent, operation identity, and repeated content
Ask for the exact prior outcome and content binding rather than comparing prose semantically
Establish prior success and an exact content match
Return the earlier result without proposing another mutation
